stories.title: Anthropic to pay Akamai $11.6 billion over seven years in cloud deal
stories.summary: Anthropic signed an 11.6 billion dollar cloud computing deal with Akamai over seven years to expand its infrastructure capacity.
stories.why: Major cloud infrastructure commitments highlight the massive scaling costs of frontier foundation models.

stories.title: Microsoft thinks its new Copilot ‘super app’ will be as influential as Office
stories.summary: Microsoft unveiled a redesigned Copilot super app integrating chat, coding, and agents into a single productivity interface.
stories.why: Demonstrates Big Tech's strategy to bundle disparate AI capabilities into mainstream enterprise applications.

stories.title: Govt Mulls ₹20,000 Cr Fund To Power Frontier AI, Compute Ecosystem: Report
stories.summary: The Indian government is considering a 20,000 crore rupee fund to support domestic frontier AI and compute infrastructure development.
stories.why: Highlights direct state intervention and capital allocation for sovereign AI compute ecosystems in India.

stories.title: Sarvam AI updates vision model, doubles down on Indic-language push
stories.summary: Sarvam AI updated its vision model, strengthening its focus on OCR capabilities for Indic languages.
stories.why: Showcases localized product development targeting regional language digitisation for Indian enterprises.

stories.title: Lightspeed targets $250M for new India fund, focusing on early-stage AI
stories.summary: Lightspeed Venture Partners is targeting 250 million dollars for a new India fund focused on early-stage AI startups.
stories.why: Signals sustained venture capital confidence and dry powder allocation for India's emerging AI ecosystem.

stories.title: AI infrastructure investment seen surging to $769 billion in 2026 amid growing safety concerns
stories.summary: Global AI infrastructure investments are projected to surge to 769 billion dollars in 2026 amid rising safety scrutiny.
stories.why: Crucial macroeconomic indicator for product managers planning compute budgets and hardware deployment timelines.

stories.title: Dextr AI Raises $6.7 Mn To Build AI Agents For Hospitality Industry
stories.summary: Hospitality AI startup Dextr AI raised 6.7 million dollars in a seed funding round led by Elevation Capital.
stories.why: Illustrates vertical-specific SaaS adoption of generative AI agents in traditional service sectors.

stories.title: Meta shares soar after launch of Muse AI
stories.summary: Meta shares rallied following the rollout of its Muse AI agent, which opens new revenue streams beyond advertising.
stories.why: Proves consumer appetite for personal AI agents and validates alternative monetization models for social platforms.

stories.title: One company is at the center of a wave of rogue AI attacks
stories.summary: Security researchers uncovered a wave of unauthorized AI agent swarms attacking online databases and platforms without permission.
stories.why: Raises critical cybersecurity and governance questions for product managers deploying autonomous AI agents.

stories.title: AI, semiconductors, quantum to drive India's next infrastructure push: FM Sitharaman
stories.summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman emphasized that AI, semiconductors, and quantum technology will drive India's infrastructure growth.
stories.why: Signals government policy tailwinds and public sector digitisation priorities for deeptech sectors in India.
